MainImage.createDescription: The selected image is cut out locally and composited onto white as a new PNG copy. No new Gemini image run or image credits. The original stays unchanged. Generate colors through Hero first, then select the result you want to use.
MainImage.sourceMissing: The original is no longer available in this view.
MainImage.shadowHint: The existing floor shadow is transferred separately onto white. Shading on the product is always preserved.
MainImage.scopeHint: For single, fully visible products on plain, light studio backgrounds. Glass, transparency, white edges and textured backgrounds may need manual retouching. This does not certify Amazon compliance.
MainImage.reviewDescription: Compare the outline, valve, logo and contact shadow. Click either image for full resolution. Background removal does not change material colors — correct a black valve through the Hero color pipeline first.
MainImage.checkLimit: Automatically checked: RGB 255/255/255 outside the product, edge and shadow masks, and unchanged pixels in the detected product interior. Pixel checks cannot detect incorrectly masked product parts. Inspect light edges and shadows yourself.
MainImage.confirmInspection: I have inspected the product outline, details and shadow at full resolution.
MainImage.started: Main processing started. The result will appear as a PNG copy for review.
MainImage.runningDescription: Local segmentation, shadow transfer and pixel checks — no Gemini tokens. CPU processing may take a few minutes.
MainImage.deleteDescription: Only this Main image copy will be permanently deleted. The original and color variants are kept.
MainImage.deleted: Main image copy deleted; the original is kept.

Generate.wtNeutralProductShotDesc: Studio-style image on a clean neutral background — ideal for secondary listing images.
Generate.wtAmazonLifestyleShotDesc: Product shown in a real-life context with a human model — perfect for lifestyle slots.
Generate.wtMainImageDesc: Product on a pure white background ready for the Amazon main image slot (Hero).
Generate.wtLifestyleDesc: Product shown in use with a model in a lifestyle setting — alias for Amazon lifestyle shot.
Generate.wtScaleReferenceDesc: Product placed next to everyday objects so shoppers can gauge its real-world size.
Generate.wtDetailCloseupDesc: Macro close-up highlighting material texture, finish, and fine product details.
Generate.wtAPlusVisualDesc: Full-width banner visual designed for A+ Content modules in Seller Central.
Generate.poseDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. sitting cross-legged, holding the ball with both hands
Generate.poseDescriptionHint: Describe the model's pose for lifestyle shots. Leave empty for an AI-selected pose.
Generate.recolorAllComponents: All product components follow the target color
Generate.recolorAllComponentsHint: Includes the valve insert, valve rim and cap. Natural shadows inside openings and the geometry are preserved. Set exceptions below.
Generate.recolorInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. The ball and valve insert always share the target color. No black plastic insert. Preserve the visible air opening.
Generate.recolorInstructionsHint: These rules apply to Hero color variants. Describe material colors and individual components. Shape, perspective, lighting and background stay locked. Relevant color facts from custom image instructions and color notes are also considered.
Generate.recolorSaved: Color rules saved — apply to new runs.
Generate.userPromptBlockPlaceholder: e.g. The logo must always be clearly visible and well-lit. Use a warm, soft lighting setup.
Generate.userPromptBlockHint: Enter instructions that should apply to every generated image — for example, logo visibility, lighting preferences, or background details. You can write in any language. Avoid pose or composition instructions.
